product.olivetti-echos-24.summary: The Echos 24 debuted with a 340 MB disk and Windows printer setup.
product.olivetti-echos-24.history: Computerwoche reported the Echos 24 introduction at CeBIT 1995 in Olivetti’s notebook range.
product.olivetti-echos-24.architecture: Printer setup used files on the disk. The report cites an enhanced parallel port, MS-DOS 6.2 and Windows 3.1.
product.olivetti-echos-24.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-echos-24.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
